title: ssopt: automated tuning of Thomas-Fermi scaling parameters for SUPERSTRUCTURE
description: Surrogate-model optimiser that tunes the lambda_nl scaling parameters of the atomic structure code SUPERSTRUCTURE against NIST energy levels with no per-ion input. It makes level labels consistent with NIST where the energies decide it, checks A-values and level lifetimes against NIST, NORAD and measured values, and writes NORAD-format tables.
